title: A hold with no end: a refused out-of-range profile value is kept, so another writer's profile change stays unshown until the person repairs that field, with no sign on the page
evidence: Root fix R13 (triage 2026-11-25): one record-apply hold state that ends on the next profile save that settles, landed or refused (US-34 AC8, R13 PR 2: the relay's `settled` event; useProfileSave no longer skips it on a refused value). HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx US-34 AC8: height 400 left, a remote birthYear 1981 held, then the next save (fixed or refused again) shows it once and keeps the typed height. Left (owner ruling 2026-11-25): a remote change that arrives after a refused save is held again until the next profile save; telling a refused value apart from a half-typed one needs its own state in the union and is left for a follow-up
